title: Item:Shocking Forum Post
wikitext:
[[File:Shocking Forum Post shown.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Shocking Forum Post]] '''Shocking Forum Post''' is a club purchasable with {{Item|Party Favor}}s, earned during the [[Anniversary Party|DDO Anniversary Party]]. Six versions are available, for ML 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30. Similar posts are also available for other spellpowers. All have identical stats for their respective energy types. :* Acid ('''caustic forum posts''') :* Cold ('''icy forum posts''') :* Electricity ('''shocking forum posts''', show below) :* Fire ('''flaming forum posts''') :* Negative Energy/Necromancy ('''necrotic forum posts''') :* Sonic ('''clamorous forum posts''') The combat stats for the various "posts" are as a [[club]] - nothing fancy there. For comparison, the numerical values are the maximum available from [[Cannith Crafting/table 3b|Cannith Crafting]] the same effects on an item for that same Minimum Level. However a CC'd item could only have 2 of either Spell Power, Lore or Wizardy (plus Insightful Spell Power), and at best would have a Red augment slot.
